series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits a moderate downward trend with strong seasonality. High spectral entropy indicates significant noise, while unstable rankings suggest model performance varies. Stacking (stl_hierarchical_stacking) is recommended to combine models effectively, avoiding baseline methods due to redundancy.

reasoning.stl_hierarchical_stacking_p4_sh0.2: series_profile.seasonality.strength=strong AND model_landscape.models_redundant=true → STL decomposition-aware stacking exploits trend/seasonal component differences
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=0.2281) → soft combiners with shrinkage are more robust than hard selection
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → per-horizon selection captures differentiated model performance across horizons

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND n_windows=2 → ridge overfits with few training windows
